questions.q: What has he done with AWS?
questions.a: At Bancolombia he works with AWS services in enterprise environments. In his own projects he deploys sites to S3 + CloudFront + Route 53, with infrastructure in CloudFormation and GitHub Actions pipelines.
A deployment platform for his sites (GitHub Actions → S3 + CloudFront), the website for Corporación Profecan, a rental listing page and, in progress, a semantic movie-review search engine using RAG.
Java is his main language: Spring Boot, APIs and microservices at Bancolombia, and before that as a Java developer at CODALTEC, the Colombian Aeronautical Industry Corporation and Inter-telco.
He wants to apply what he knows about enterprise software to LLM systems: how they behave with real data, how to evaluate them and how to take them to production without exposing credentials.

questions.q: What does he know about RAG?
questions.a: He's building his first RAG system: embeddings in Supabase pgvector, orchestration with LangChain and LangGraph, and a Lambda backend. This knowledge base is that system.
